name: DotField-TS-TW

frames.best_why: The purple glow sits centred with the dot grid clearly bent around it.

tagline: A purple glow bends a grid of tiny dots as the cursor moves.
summary: A near-black background covered in a fine grid of small violet dots. A soft purple glow follows the pointer and pushes the nearby dots outward, then they settle back.
appearance: A dark field of evenly spaced tiny violet dots on near-black, brighter toward the top and fading at the edges. At rest it reads as a fine grid; where the pointer sits, a soft purple halo blooms and the dots around it swell apart.
behaviour: Moving the cursor drags a purple glow and a bulge through the grid, pushing nearby dots outward while distant ones spring back; when the pointer stops, the glow fades. A gentle wave can also ripple the rows.
demo_content: A heading 'Dot Field' with the line 'Move your cursor to bend the grid.'
search_phrases: cursor bends a field of dots
purple glow on a dotted backdrop
subtle dot matrix background for a hero
dots push away from the pointer
dark grid with a light following the mouse
use_when: You want a technical, understated background that reacts to the pointer behind a dark hero or product page.
avoid_when: It only reacts to a mouse, so touch users see a static dot grid, and the effect never fully settles.
customise: Props set dot radius and spacing, cursor radius and force, bulge-only mode and strength, glow radius and colour, sparkle, wave amplitude and the two gradient colours.
weight_why: A 2D canvas redraws a grid of roughly two thousand dots every frame.

a11y.note: The dot grid animates continuously and reacts only to a mouse; it ignores reduced-motion and has no label.

issues: It only reacts to a mouse; touch and keyboard users just see a static grid.
The animation loop runs forever, even when nothing is moving.
polish_why: Crisp dot grid and a smooth purple glow, but it is a familiar effect and pointer-only.
title: Dot Field
